newsitem.title: IRAQ: Iraq says allied planes carry out 42 sorties.
newsitem.headline: Iraq says allied planes carry out 42 sorties.

text.p: Iraq said on Friday that U.S. and allied aircraft made 42 sorties over its southern skies but did not say whether its air defence units fired at them.
"American planes and those assisting them violated Iraqi airspace, carrying out 42 sorties in the southern sector," the Iraqi News Agency (INA) said, quoting a military spokesman.
The spokesman did not say whether U.S. and allied warplanes that police another zone in northern Iraq had also penetrated Iraqi space.
The Western planes are policing "no-fly" zones for Iraqi aircraft in the north and south of the country, set up after the 1991 Gulf War.
On Thursday the Iraqi spokesman said Iraq fired three anti-aircraft missiles in southern Iraq. The missiles did not hit any planes.
